# Circle

> > Circle is a global financial technology company that issues USDC and EURC stablecoins, providing Web3 infrastructure, developer APIs, and regulated digital currency solutions for institutions, banks, and developers.

Circle operates as a leading stablecoin issuer with products including USDC (USD Coin), EURC (Euro Coin), Circle Mint, programmable wallets, and cross-chain transfer protocol (CCTP). The company serves banks, institutions, and developers while advancing financial inclusion through Circle Impact initiatives.

## Key Topics

- USDC (USD Coin)
- EURC (Euro Coin)
- Stablecoins
- Circle Mint
- CCTP (Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol)

## Core Products & Services

- [Web3 APIs & SDKs](https://www.circle.com/developer): Developer platform for USDC integration with Web3 APIs, wallets & SDKs
- [Banking Solutions](https://www.circle.com/banks): Banking solutions: USDC, Circle Mint & regulated stablecoin infrastructure
- [Circle Launches Web3 Wallet Service for Developers](https://www.circle.com/pressroom/circle-launches-web3-wallet-service-for-developers): Programmable Wallets beta launch for USDC & EUROC integration
- [Announcing USDC v2.2](https://www.circle.com/blog/announcing-usdc-v2-2): USDC v2.2 upgrade: reduced gas costs, EIP-1271 support & enhanced security
